mapper.select: INSERT INTO llm_call_log (node, novel_id, chapter_id, model, prompt_tokens, cached_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, status, error_msg, reasoning_text, request_json, response_json) VALUES (#{node}, #{novelId}, #{chapterId}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{cachedTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{reasoningText}::text, #{requestJson}::jsonb, #{responseJson}::jsonb) RETURNING id

SELECT * FROM llm_call_log WHERE is_deleted=false AND (#{novelId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR novel_id=#{novelId}) AND (#{chapterId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR chapter_id=#{chapterId}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM llm_call_log WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_call_log WHERE is_deleted=false AND (#{novelId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR novel_id=#{novelId}) AND (#{chapterId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR chapter_id=#{chapterId})

SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "calls", COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens),0)::bigint AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens),0)::bigint AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens),0)::bigint AS "totalTokens", COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms),0)::bigint AS "avgLatencyMs" FROM llm_call_log WHERE is_deleted=false AND (#{novelId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR novel_id=#{novelId}) AND (#{chapterId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR chapter_id=#{chapterId})

SELECT l.node, l.model, (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM l.create_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') >= p.peak_start_hour AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM l.create_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < p.peak_end_hour) AS "peak", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "calls", COALESCE(SUM(l.prompt_tokens),0)::bigint AS "promptTokens", COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l.cached_tokens,0)),0)::bigint AS "cachedTokens", COALESCE(SUM(l.completion_tokens),0)::bigint AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(l.latency_ms),0)::bigint AS "latencySum" FROM llm_call_log l LEFT JOIN llm_model_price p ON p.model = l.model AND p.is_deleted=false AND p.enabled=true WHERE l.is_deleted=false AND l.create_time > NOW() - ((#{days}) || ' days')::interval GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1
